items.headline: University of Delaware joins Google Books Library Project to curate scholarly sources for AI training
items.excerpt: The University of Delaware announced it has joined the Google Books Library Project, saying its participation will help ensure future AI systems are trained on reliable, scholarly, well-curated sources while preserving source attribution and bibliographic context. It reframes the library/AI-training debate around consented, high-quality corpora rather than scraped pirate libraries.
items.overlap_flag: net-new; not present in sections.books history

items.headline: Hong Kong Book Fair centers its 2026 edition on 'Reading for All in the Age of AI'
items.excerpt: The 36th HKTDC Hong Kong Book Fair, which closed July 21, ran under the theme 'Reading for All in the Age of AI: Reshaping and Co-evolution,' with publishers debating how AI could raise reading efficiency and cultivate critical, in-depth thinking through cross-sector cooperation. A snapshot of how a major Asian trade fair is framing AI's role in reading and publishing culture.
items.overlap_flag: net-new AI angle; distinct from the already-carded IPA Congress AI panel (07-24)
